images.alt: A political advertisement showing a flooded rural landscape with muddy water covering fields and partially submerging a road. Large dark green text reads, “OUR COMMUNITIES ARE TIRED.” Below, highlighted in green bars: “Tired of flooding. Tired of rising bills. Tired of picking up the pieces.” At the bottom, white text on a green background reads, “We need action that protects people not polluters.” Small text credits Marama Davidson and Chlöe Swarbrick, Green Party Co-Leaders, authorised by the Green Party in Wellington. The Green Party logo appears in the lower right corner

post.text:
Private profits are soaring while our communities struggle.

Through taxing corporations what they owe, we can protect people, not polluters.

source.agency_name: Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand
